other_failure_modes.name: Improper encoding of categorical variables for tree models
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies LabelEncoder to categorical features and subsequently casts all columns to float. This forces tree models (including CatBoost, which features powerful native categorical handling) to treat nominal categories as continuous or ordinal variables, degrading performance and split quality.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid pipeline with feature engineering, an appropriate ensemble, and handling of unseen categories. However, it fails to respect the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random train-test split, leading to look-ahead bias. Additionally, it suffers from data leakage by imputing missing values before splitting, and suboptimally casts label-encoded nominal categories to continuous floats.
